aside.title: Your balance, entry by entry.
aside.text: Every deposit, hold, investment result and withdrawal is a ledger entry you can open. Nothing is shown as earned until it has been realised.

passwordRules.not_email: Does not contain your email name
passwordRules.notMet: The password does not meet every rule yet.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to see your balances and positions.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

register.title: Open an account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute. You will confirm your email before you can sign in.
register.countryHint: Where you live, not your citizenship. Some services depend on it.
register.acceptRisk: I have read the {link} and understand I can lose money.
register.checkEmailText: If {{email}} can be used for a new account, we have sent it a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
register.checkSpam: The link expires after a while. If you do not see the email within a few minutes, check your spam folder or send it again.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.successText: Your account is active and you are signed in.
verify.successShort: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
verify.failedTitle: We could not confirm your email
verify.expired: This confirmation link has expired or was already used. Send yourself a new one.
verify.missingToken: Open the link from your confirmation email, or send yourself a new one.
verify.resent: If the address belongs to an unconfirmed account, a new link is on its way.
verify.pendingText: We sent a confirmation link when you registered. Open it, then sign in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If {{email}} belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires after a short time.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: After you change it, every other device is signed out.
reset.doneText: You are signed in on this device. Other devices have been signed out.
reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used.
reset.missingToken: Open the link from your reset email to choose a new password.
reset.successShort: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

mfa.challengeText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.pendingText: You signed in with your password. Enter your authenticator code to use your account.
